result.summary: Our patch places a canonicalize-then-verify-containment guard at exactly the same sink (AbstractUnArchiver.extractFile, right after FileUtils.resolveFile) as the official fix, throwing an ArchiverException when the resolved entry escapes the destination. Because all tar/zip unarchivers route through this single method, the entire Zip-Slip class is closed, and the POV no longer reproduces with regressions passing. The mechanism (walking canonical parents to the canonical destination) is actually stronger than the official startsWith prefix check, which is vulnerable to sibling-directory prefix false-matches (e.g. dest /a/b vs escape /a/bc). This is a correct, sound fix.
result.root_cause: Untrusted archive entry names containing "../" were resolved against the destination directory and written without verifying the resolved canonical path stayed inside that directory.
